summary.text: Jason Barrett is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who has represented District 16 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A Martinsburg restaurant owner, he previously served in the House of Delegates and chairs the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jason Barrett was born in Martinsburg, West Virginia, where he lives, and graduated from Martinsburg High School.
He earned a degree from Shepherd University, and his career experience includes working as a small business owner in the restaurant industry.
Barrett represented House of Delegates District 61 from 2012 to 2014 and again from 2016 to 2022; he was an unsuccessful Democratic candidate for District 54 in 2010.
On December 11, 2020, he announced that he was changing his party affiliation from Democrat to Republican, saying he believed joining the Republican Party was a way to be an effective legislator.
He took office in the State Senate on December 1, 2022, succeeding Hannah Geffert.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Senate Finance Committee and is vice chair of the Rules Committee.
